Order: Create Fund View Table -> Delete Rows (DTSX:7370). When POW_MAIN changes for an existing 5-key combination: the insert Lookup matches (Match output unconnected), so no insert. Delete Rows: no 6-key match, so delete. Next run: no 5-key match, so insert with the new POW_MAIN, which then matches and is kept. The combination is missing for exactly one run interval. Additional trigger not mentioned: the lookup query is a separate execution of the same SQL, so a RowNum tie (equal POW start dates) can pick a different POW_MAIN than the inserted row and cause the same delete/re-insert cycle.
